source.description: Written by Ekos Labs from the method behind its own launch films. Bundles a Remotion template with a coded 3D character, audio and mastering scripts. Fonts are installed from npm (Inter and Instrument Serif, SIL Open Font License). No upstream skill files are bundled.

dependencies: Remotion 4 and three.js (installed by the bundled template)
Optional: ElevenLabs API key for the voice
Optional: mlx-whisper or faster-whisper for exact word timing
